strings.jp: 栄誉の証を貴方に授けます
strings.en:
I bestow upon you
this mark of honor.

strings.jp: 貴殿に褒賞をとらせよう
strings.en:
I shall grant you a
reward.

strings.jp: 貴方に褒賞を授けましょう
strings.en:
Let me bestow a
reward upon you.

strings.jp: 頑張ったヤツにはご褒美だ
strings.en:
Those who work hard
get a reward!

strings.jp: おめぇらに褒美をやるぞぉ!
strings.en:
I'm givin' you lot a
reward, ya hear!

strings.jp: 褒美じゃあ!　受け取れい!
名誉の証だ。受け取るがいい
strings.en:
A token of honor.
You may accept it.

strings.jp:
恩賜のメダリオンじゃ。
受け取るが良い
strings.en:
A Medallion, by my
grace. Take it, eh.

Here's a reward for
you, darling.

I grant you this mark
of honor.

strings.jp:
貴方に…栄誉の証を
授けましょう。フフフ…
strings.en:
To you... a mark of
honor. Heh heh heh...
